parameters.name: AlertTime
parameters.description: Specifies the number of time units for the offset from the deadline.

parameters.name: AlertTimeUnit
parameters.description: Specifies the time unit type for the offset from the deadline.

parameters.name: AllowDownloadFromMicrosoftUpdate
parameters.description: Use this parameter to set the following option on the Download Settings page of the ADR deployment settings: If software updates are not available on distribution point in current, neighbor or site boundary groups, download content from Microsoft Updates.

parameters.name: AllowRestart
parameters.description: Indicates whether a system restart is allowed to be performed outside of any defined maintenance windows when the installation deadline is reached.

parameters.name: AllowSoftwareInstallationOutsideMaintenanceWindow
parameters.description: Indicates whether software installation is allowed to be performed outside of any defined maintenance windows when the installation deadline is reached.

parameters.name: AllowUseMeteredNetwork
parameters.description: Use this parameter to set the following option on the Download Settings page of the ADR deployment settings: Allow clients on a metered Internet connection to download content after the installation deadline, which might incur additionl costs

parameters.name: AvailableImmediately
parameters.description: Indicates whether software updates are available to install as soon as possible after the rule is run.

parameters.name: AvailableTime
parameters.description: Specifies the number of time units for the software available time.

parameters.name: AvailableTimeUnit
parameters.description: Specifies the time unit type for the software available time.

parameters.name: Collection
parameters.description: Specifies a target collection object for the software update deployment. To obtain a collection object, use the Get-CMCollection cmdlet.

parameters.name: CollectionId
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of the target collection for the software update deployment.

parameters.name: CollectionName
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the target collection for the software update deployment.

parameters.name: DeadlineImmediately
parameters.description: Indicates whether required software updates are installed as soon as possible when the deadline is reached.

parameters.name: DeadlineTime
parameters.description: Specifies the number of time units for the deadline.

parameters.name: DeadlineTimeUnit
parameters.description: Specifies the time unit type for the deadline.

parameters.name: DisableOperationsManager
parameters.description: Indicates whether Operations Manager alerts are disabled while software updates run.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: EnableDeployment
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the deployment after this rule runs for the associated software group. If set to $False, manually deploy the software update group.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: GenerateOperationsManagerAlert
parameters.description: Indicates whether Operations Manager alerts are generated when a software update installation fails.

parameters.name: GenerateSuccessAlert
parameters.description: Indicates whether an alert is generated when this rule runs successfully.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of the automatic deployment rule to add this deployment to.

parameters.name: InputObject
parameters.description: Specifies an automatic deployment rule object to add this deployment to. To obtain an automatic deployment rule object, use the Get-CMSoftwareUpdateAutoDeploymentRule cmdlet.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the automatic deployment rule to add this deployment to.

parameters.name: NoInstallOnRemote
parameters.description: Indicates whether to install software updates when the updates are not available on any remote distribution points.

parameters.name: NoInstallOnUnprotected
parameters.description: Indicates whether to install software updates when the updates are not available on any unprotected distribution points.

parameters.name: RequirePostRebootFullScan
parameters.description: Use this parameter to set the following option on the User Experience page of the ADR deployment settings: If any update in this deployment requires a system restart, run updates deployment evaluation cycle after restart.

parameters.name: SendWakeupPacket
parameters.description: Indicates whether to use Wake-on-LAN to wake up clients for required deployments.

parameters.name: SoftDeadlineEnabled
parameters.description: Use this parameter to set the following option on the Deployment Schedule page of the ADR deployment settings: Delay enforcement of this deployment according to user preferences, up to the grace period defined in client settings.

parameters.name: SuccessPercentage
parameters.description: Specifies the percent as an integer of client compliance. When client compliance falls below this percentage, an alert is generated.

parameters.name: SuppressRestartServer
parameters.description: Indicates whether a system restart is suppressed on servers when a software update requires a system restart to complete the installation process.

parameters.name: SuppressRestartWorkstation
parameters.description: Indicates whether a system restart is suppressed on workstations when a software update requires a system restart to complete the installation process.

parameters.name: UseBranchCache
parameters.description: Indicates whether clients are allowed to share content with other clients on the same subnet.

parameters.name: UserNotification
parameters.description: Specifies the notification behavior of the user visual experience.

parameters.name: UseUtc
parameters.description: Indicates whether the schedule for this deployment is evaluated based upon Universal Coordinated Time (UTC).

parameters.name: VerboseLevel
parameters.description: Specifies how much state detail the clients report back for deployments created by this rule.

parameters.name: WriteFilterHandling
parameters.description: Indicates whether changes are committed at deadline or during a maintenance window (requires restarts). If set to $False, content is applied on the overlay and committed later.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Prompts you for confirmation before running the cmdlet.

parameters.name: WhatIf
parameters.description: Shows what would happen if the cmdlet runs. The cmdlet doesn't run.

$Deployment = $ReferenceADR | Get-CMAutoDeploymentRuleDeployment
Set-CMAutoDeploymentRuleDeployment -InputObject $Deployment[0] -CollectionName "All Systems" -EnableDeployment $True -SendWakeupPacket $False -VerboseLevel OnlySuccessAndErrorMessages -UseUtc $False -AvailableTime 7 -AvailableTimeUnit Days -DeadlineTime 7 -DeadlineTimeUnit Days -UserNotification DisplaySoftwareCenterOnly -AllowSoftwareInstallationOutsideMaintenanceWindow $False -AllowRestart $False -SuppressRestartServer $False -SuppressRestartWorkstation $False -WriteFilterHandling $False -GenerateSuccessAlert $True -SuccessPercentage 10 -AlertTime 7 -AlertTimeUnit Days -DisableOperationsManager $False -GenerateOperationsManagerAlert $False -NoInstallOnRemote $False -NoInstallOnUnprotected $False -UseBranchCache $False

parameters.name: AlertTime
parameters.description: Specifies the number of time units for the offset from the deadline.

parameters.name: AlertTimeUnit
parameters.description: Specifies the time unit type for the offset from the deadline. Valid values are: - Hours - Days - Weeks - Months

parameters.name: AllowDownloadFromMicrosoftUpdate
parameters.description: Use this parameter to set the following option on the Download Settings page of the ADR deployment settings: If software updates are not available on distribution point in current, neighbor or site boundary groups, download content from Microsoft Updates.

parameters.name: AllowRestart
parameters.description: Indicates whether a system restart is allowed to be performed outside of any defined maintenance windows when the installation deadline is reached.

parameters.name: AllowSoftwareInstallationOutsideMaintenanceWindow
parameters.description: Indicates whether software installation is allowed to be performed outside of any defined maintenance windows when the installation deadline is reached.

parameters.name: AllowUseMeteredNetwork
parameters.description: Use this parameter to set the following option on the Download Settings page of the ADR deployment settings: Allow clients on a metered Internet connection to download content after the installation deadline, which might incur additionl costs

parameters.name: AvailableImmediately
parameters.description: Indicates whether software updates are available to install as soon as possible after the rule is run.

parameters.name: AvailableTime
parameters.description: Specifies the number of time units for the software available time.

parameters.name: AvailableTimeUnit
parameters.description: Specifies the time unit type for the software available time. Valid values are: - Hours - Days - Weeks - Months

parameters.name: Collection
parameters.description: Specifies a target collection object for the software update deployment. To obtain a collection object, use the Get-CMCollection cmdlet.

parameters.name: CollectionId
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of the target collection for the software update deployment.

parameters.name: CollectionName
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the target collection for the software update deployment.

parameters.name: DeadlineImmediately
parameters.description: Indicates whether required software updates are installed as soon as possible when the deadline is reached.

parameters.name: DeadlineTime
parameters.description: Specifies the number of time units for the deadline.

parameters.name: DeadlineTimeUnit
parameters.description: Specifies the time unit type for the deadline. Valid values are: - Hours - Days - Weeks - Months

parameters.name: DisableOperationsManager
parameters.description: Indicates whether Operations Manager alerts are disabled while software updates run.

parameters.name: DisableWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter treats wildcard characters as literal character values. You can't combine it with ForceWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: EnableDeployment
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable the deployment after this rule runs for the associated software group. If set to $False, you must manually deploy the software update group.

parameters.name: ForceWildcardHandling
parameters.description: This parameter processes wildcard characters and may lead to unexpected behavior (not recommended). You can't combine it with DisableWildcardHandling.

parameters.name: GenerateOperationsManagerAlert
parameters.description: Indicates whether Operations Manager alerts are generated when a software update installation fails.

parameters.name: GenerateSuccessAlert
parameters.description: Indicates whether an alert is generated when this rule runs successfully.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Specifies the action ID of the automatic deployment rule deployment.

parameters.name: InputObject
parameters.description: Specifies an automatic deployment rule object. To obtain an automatic deployment rule object, use the Get-CMSoftwareUpdateAutoDeploymentRule cmdlet.

parameters.name: NoInstallOnRemote
parameters.description: Indicates whether to install software updates when the updates are not available on any remote distribution points.

parameters.name: NoInstallOnUnprotected
parameters.description: Indicates whether to install software updates when the updates are not available on any unprotected distribution points.

parameters.name: PassThru
parameters.description: Add this parameter to return an object that represents the item with which you're working. By default, this cmdlet may not generate any output.

parameters.name: RequirePostRebootFullScan
parameters.description: Use this parameter to set the following option on the User Experience page of the ADR deployment settings: If any update in this deployment requires a system restart, run updates deployment evaluation cycle after restart.

parameters.name: SendWakeupPacket
parameters.description: Indicates whether to use Wake-on-LAN to wake up clients for required deployments.

parameters.name: SoftDeadlineEnabled
parameters.description: Use this parameter to set the following option on the Deployment Schedule page of the ADR deployment settings: Delay enforcement of this deployment according to user preferences, up to the grace period defined in client settings.

parameters.name: SuccessPercentage
parameters.description: Specifies the percent, as an integer, of client compliance. When client compliance falls below this percentage, an alert is generated.

parameters.name: SuppressRestartServer
parameters.description: Indicates whether a system restart is suppressed on servers when a software update requires a system restart to complete the installation process.

parameters.name: SuppressRestartWorkstation
parameters.description: Indicates whether a system restart is suppressed on workstations when a software update requires a system restart to complete the installation process.

parameters.name: UseBranchCache
parameters.description: Indicates whether clients are allowed to share content with other clients on the same subnet.

parameters.name: UserNotification
parameters.description: Specifies the notification behavior of the user visual experience. Valid values are: - DisplayAll - DisplaySoftwareCenterOnly - HideAll

parameters.name: UseUtc
parameters.description: Indicates whether the schedule for this deployment is evaluated based upon Universal Coordinated Time (UTC).

parameters.name: VerboseLevel
parameters.description: Specifies how much state detail the clients report back for deployments created by this rule. Valid values are: - OnlyErrorMessages - OnlySuccessAndErrorMessages - AllMessages

parameters.name: WriteFilterHandling
parameters.description: Indicates whether changes are committed at deadline or during a maintenance window (requires restarts). If set to $False, content is applied on the overlay and committed later.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description: Prompts you for confirmation before running the cmdlet.

parameters.name: WhatIf
parameters.description: Shows what would happen if the cmdlet runs. The cmdlet doesn't run.
